claims.claim: The newspaper paraphrases Hendrix saying the sheriff’s office received an anonymous letter weeks earlier; it reports a request for the same writer to write again. The underlying letter is not held.
claims.assessment_rationale: Source-attributed reporting in readable photograph; original issue and underlying agency records not authenticated.
